commits.message: stepped-ink's frame-cost test plays both passes of the beat, so a cache kept per step is caught (rich-unfiled-791c.2i8o)

stepped-ink's frame-cost test counts the search's work instead of timing it (rich-unfiled-791c.2i8o)

The wall-clock comparison failed on loaded GitHub runners with no code
change touching it. The property it pinned — a step's frames reuse the
step's search — is now asserted by counting Effected.shows calls: the
step's first frame makes some, every frame inside the step and the step's
next pass of the beat make none. Bypassing the memo in steppedInk fails it.

An effect's next change is asked with the frame it draws (rich-animation-xi28.3an)

Effect.nextChange took only t, so stillOnSlots — identity at the
sixteen-colour depths — answered t and a Live repainted still content at
its rate. The signature mirrors the first stage, (t, drawn), and Effected
stamps after it has measured the frame, with the one measure.

onBeat answered the hold's end whatever the inner effect said: a beat
over a done transition said a time where the inner said never. It now
answers the first hold start at or after the inner's next change from the
hold's start, and never when the inner says never.

withNextChange takes an Effect and says its answer replaces the inner's;
confined hands its narrowed frame to both stages. Live reads the soonest
change off its rows without flattening them.

The showcase's flash is a composer over the hue walk, answering the
sooner of its own next flash and the walk's step, in place of two nested
Effected and a heading that spelled the signal's next step.

Found by /code-review high on release PR #423; lands before v0.24.0 is
tagged, since the signature is public.

claude-sessions counts a line skipped only when it holds no record (rich-demos-k78j.zs7) (#422)

* claude-sessions counts a line skipped only when a record failed to parse (rich-demos-k78j.zs7)

loadSession counted every blank line as skipped, so the newline that ends
every JSONL file showed as '(1 lines skipped)' on every session opened in
Node. A blank line carries no record; only a non-blank line that fails to
parse is now counted.

* claude-sessions reads a JSONL line as a record only when it holds an object (rich-demos-k78j.zs7)

A line holding JSON that is not an object (null, 42, []) was cast to a
record: a null line failed the whole session's load in readRecords, and in
the scanner's title window it failed the project scan. jsonlRecord is now
the one reading of a line as a record, shared by loader and scanner, and a
line it rejects is counted as skipped.

The status line says "1 line" / "1 block", and the clean-file test asserts
the loaded status rather than the absence of "skipped".
